preconditions.description: The input root must be a valid TreeNode object.
The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in nodes)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the tree must be valid TreeNode objects.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(head, TreeNode) or head is None
postconditions.description: The output head must be a valid TreeNode object or None if the tree is empty.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None and node.right is None for node in dll_nodes)
postconditions.description: All nodes in the DLL must be leaf nodes of the original tree.
The number of nodes in the DLL must equal the number of leaf nodes in the original tree.
